attrs.title: How far is {{name}} from Melbourne and the airport?

attrs.content: {{name}} is at {{address}}, in the Dandenong Ranges. It’s a 40-minute drive from Melbourne’s CBD and 50 minutes from Melbourne (Tullamarine) Airport.

attrs.title: What types of rooms are available?

attrs.content: {{name}} has 62 guest rooms plus a self-contained cottage. Choose from Standard Queen Rooms (12 square metres, queen bed), Standard King Rooms (16 square metres, king bed that splits into 2 singles), Superior King Rooms (20 square metres, king bed that splits into 2 singles) and The Cottage (90 square metres, 2 bedrooms, full kitchen and laundry). All rooms have air-conditioning, an en-suite, a smart TV and free Wi-Fi.

Yes. {{name}} has 2 pet-friendly rooms in a separate area away from the main guest hallways, so pet owners and other guests can both enjoy a comfortable stay. Pets are only permitted in these rooms, so please let us know you’re bringing a pet when you book.
Yes. Free on-site parking is available for all guests, including space for RVs, buses and coaches, and complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the property, including all guest rooms.

attrs.title: Does {{name}} have a pool and other facilities?

attrs.content: Yes. Facilities include a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, 2 tennis courts, a basketball court, volleyball, a gym, jogging trails and bush walks, plus lounge bars, an open fireplace and pool tables indoors.

{{name}} sits beside Dandenong Ranges National Park. Sky High Mount Dandenong and the National Rhododendron Gardens are 7 minutes away, Olinda Village and Alfred Nicholas Memorial Gardens 8 minutes, and Puffing Billy Railway at Belgrave 32 minutes. Yarra Valley wineries such as Domaine Chandon, De Bortoli and Coombe Yarra Valley are within easy driving distance.

attrs.title: Do you host conferences, corporate retreats and weddings?

seo.title: Conference Venue Dandenong Ranges | {{name}}
seo.description: Award-winning Dandenong Ranges conference venue. 5 conference rooms for up to 120 delegates, plus weddings, retreats & functions, 40 min from Melbourne CBD.

attrs.content: Premier Conference & Function Venue in the Dandenong Ranges
Unwind in the lush gardens and tranquil setting of {{name}}

Panorama Centre is a self-contained conference and function facility within the Retreat complex. The centre offers executive guest rooms, private dining, a bar, a recreation area, and comprehensive conference facilities.

Panorama Centre features 62 double guest rooms, 5 conference rooms, 10 syndicate rooms, team-building facilities, and a range of recreational services, including tennis, volleyball, billiards, a weights room, and a swimming pool.

image.alt: Conference room set up with tables facing a presentation screen
Delegates networking in the bright conference foyer

attrs.content: The centre accommodates up to 120 delegates, with conference rooms featuring advanced audio-visual equipment and wireless internet. These rooms also offer natural light, ergonomic chairs, air conditioning, and lighting controls.

Recreational facilities include a tennis court, weights room, swimming pool, volleyball, jogging trails, bush walks, and nearby golf. Indoor activities at the venue feature billiards, foosball tables, open fires, and bar/lounges.

{{name}} is the ideal destination for retreats and workshops, offering a variety of outdoor spaces and versatile facilities to suit your needs. Our tranquil environment and stunning natural surroundings provide the perfect setting for creative thinking, team-building, and relaxation.

Host your retreat in our spacious conference rooms, surrounded by panoramic views and ample natural light. For a more immersive experience, our expansive gardens and outdoor areas are perfect for group activities, mindfulness sessions, and workshops. Whether you’re planning a corporate retreat, wellness workshop, or creative seminar, our adaptable spaces cater to every requirement.

{{name}} offers the perfect setting for your social events, combining elegance and flexibility to create unforgettable experiences. Whether you’re planning a wedding, anniversary celebration, birthday party, or any other special occasion, our dedicated team is here to bring your vision to life.

Our picturesque surroundings and versatile event spaces provide a stunning backdrop for your celebration. Exchange vows in our lush gardens, surrounded by vibrant blooms and towering trees, creating a romantic and unforgettable atmosphere. With exceptional service and meticulous attention to detail, {{name}} promises to make your social event truly memorable.

attrs.content: Yes. {{name}} is a residential conference centre in the Dandenong Ranges, 40 minutes from the Melbourne CBD, with 5 conference rooms, 10 syndicate (breakout) rooms and 62 guest rooms on site. It was the first conference centre in Australia accredited by the International Association of Conference Centres (IACC) and is the only conference centre inducted into the Victorian Tourism Hall of Fame.

attrs.title: How many people can {{name}} hold for a conference?

attrs.content: Up to 120 delegates across the conference and breakout facilities. The Shiloah Room seats 110 theatre-style or 80 classroom-style, the Outlook Room seats 80 theatre-style, the Forest Room 40, the Silvan Room 30, and the Waratah boardroom 14 board-style.

attrs.title: Are there breakout rooms and audio-visual equipment?

attrs.content: Yes. There are 10 syndicate (breakout) rooms. Conference rooms have audio-visual equipment, wireless internet, natural light, air-conditioning, lighting controls and ergonomic chairs. The Shiloah Room also has electronic blackout blinds, an integrated presentation sound system and rear projection.
Yes. With 62 guest rooms and a self-contained cottage on site, delegates can meet, dine and stay on one property, which makes {{name}} ideal for residential conferences and multi-day programs.

attrs.title: Is {{name}} good for corporate retreats and team building?

attrs.content: Yes. {{name}} is a full-service corporate retreat venue set on 10 acres of gardens and native forest, 40 minutes from the Melbourne CBD. Teams can meet, dine and stay on site, and use the pool, tennis, basketball and volleyball courts, jogging trails, bush walks and open lawns for team-building activities.

attrs.title: Can you host executive offsites, board meetings and workshops?

attrs.content: Yes. The Waratah boardroom seats 14 and opens onto a viewing deck overlooking Silvan Dam and the Yarra Valley. The quiet Silvan Room has floor-to-ceiling views for up to 30, and the Forest Room has its own syndicate rooms and courtyards for a private conference area. The gardens and lawns also suit wellness retreats, mindfulness sessions and creative workshops.

attrs.title: Is there parking for buses and coaches?

attrs.content: Yes. Free on-site parking is available for cars, buses and coaches, so groups can travel together.

attrs.title: How do I enquire about a conference or event?

attrs.content: Use the enquiry form on this page with your preferred date, type of event and estimated number of guests, or call us on {{phone}}.
Contact us! We’ll be happy to help.

seo.title: Conference & Meeting Rooms | {{name}}
seo.description: Compare 5 conference rooms at {{name}} — from the 110-seat Shiloah Room to the intimate Waratah boardroom — plus 5 private syndicate rooms.

attrs.content:
Panorama Centre is a self-contained conference and function facility within the Retreat complex. The centre offers executive guest rooms, private dining, a bar, a recreation area, and comprehensive conference facilities.
Panorama Centre features 62 double guest rooms, 5 conference rooms, 10 syndicate rooms, team-building facilities, and a range of recreational services, including tennis, volleyball, billiards, a weights room, and a swimming pool.

The largest of our conference rooms is quite spectacular.
Airconditioned with large feature windows that allow lots of natural light in. Electronically operated blinds provide total blackout at the press of a button. The integrated presentation sound system, wireless access and high quality rear projection for LCD and video all make this one of the best conference rooms you will ever work in.
Syndicate Rooms: Tremont, Olinda, Ferny Creek, Montrose, Kallista

A large room with lots of windows offering wonderful views of the gardens, the Silvan Dam and Yarra Valley beyond. Loads of natural light. Close to all conference amenities including the main dining room and the viewing deck, perfect for cocktails.
Ideal for medium to large groups.

This is a perfect room for small to medium sized groups.
The room with an unforgettable view. Towering floor to ceiling windows provide a panoramic view of the Silvan Dam, the forest and the magnificent gardens. A popular conference room located away from the busy centre of the venue. Very quiet and private.

As the name suggests, the Forest Room is surrounded by towering Mountain Ash trees and ferns. Adjoining syndicate rooms make this a completely private conference area. Outside there are 3 attractive courtyards for meeting breaks and enjoying the fresh mountain air. A lovely quiet setting for medium sized groups.

The “Board Room”. An intimate meeting room ideal for smaller groups. Also doubles as a private dining room.
Waratah is centrally located close to all facilities. Glass doors open onto the viewing deck offering wonderful views to the Silvan Reservoir and right down the picturesque Yarra Valley.

attrs.content: {{name}} sits on high ground overlooking Silvan Dam and the Yarra Valley, right next to Dandenong Ranges National Park. Towering Mountain Ash, fern gullies and open lawns surround the property, making it a peaceful base for a weekend getaway, a corporate retreat or a wedding in the hills.

Choose from Standard Queen, Standard King and Superior King rooms, or our 90 m² self-contained Cottage with two bedrooms, a full kitchen and a private terrace. Every room has air-conditioning, an en-suite and free Wi-Fi. Explore our rooms and accommodation.

Our five conference rooms host up to 120 delegates, from the 110-seat Shiloah Room to the 14-seat Waratah boardroom, with 10 breakout rooms and 62 guest rooms on site. {{name}} is the only conference centre inducted into the Victorian Tourism Hall of Fame. See our conference venue.

Between meetings or sightseeing, enjoy the seasonal outdoor pool, tennis courts, basketball and volleyball, jogging trails and bush walks. Indoors there are lounge bars, an open fireplace, pool tables and a gym.

The best of the Dandenong Ranges is on our doorstep. Sky High Mount Dandenong and the National Rhododendron Gardens are 7 minutes away, Olinda Village and Alfred Nicholas Memorial Gardens 8 minutes, and Puffing Billy Railway 32 minutes. Find more things to do nearby.

Our landscaped gardens, vibrant blooms and towering trees are a favourite with guests, and a stunning setting for garden wedding ceremonies, outdoor team activities and quiet morning walks. Discover weddings at {{name}}.
With native forest all around, {{name}} is a haven for bird watching. Keep an eye out for them around the gardens and viewing deck, especially in the early morning.
Indulge in the Dandenong Ranges’ Finest

seo.title: About {{name}} | Award-Winning Dandenong Ranges Venue
seo.description: Formerly Country Place, {{name}} has welcomed guests for almost 25 years — a 5-time Victorian Tourism Award winner in the Dandenong Ranges.

attrs.content: Formerly known as Country Place, {{name}} is a renowned venue for conferences, functions, and accommodation, nestled in the stunning Dandenong Ranges, just east of Melbourne. With nearly 25 years of operation in this picturesque location, our venue offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and convenience. Perched on high ground overlooking Silvan Dam and the scenic Yarra Valley, {{name}} boasts breathtaking views and serene surroundings. Best of all, we’re only a 40-minute drive from Melbourne’s CBD, making us an ideal choice for both business and leisure escapes.

{{name}} is located right in the heart of the Dandenong Ranges. The surrounding forest and clear mountain air will take your breath away. A contemplative walk or energising jog through the nearby trails will leave you refreshed and revitalised.

The land on which {{name}} sits is one of the most historic locations in The Dandenong Ranges. The first settlers to the region came to Kalorama. Several of the most popular early guesthouses were located near {{name}}, with Shiloah guest house (shown opposite) being situated on Link Road near the {{name}} car park. The famous Cobb & Co Coach stopped nearby on its way to Melbourne.

seo.title: Privacy Policy %sep% {{name}}
seo.description: Read how {{name}} collects, uses and protects your personal information when you visit our website or book a stay or event with us.

attrs.content:
{{name}}, located at {{address}}, is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect through our website, how we use it, who we share it with, and the choices you have.
By using our Website or providing us with your personal information, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

We may collect the following types of personal information:
Contact details — name, email address, phone number, postal address
Booking and stay details — arrival/departure dates, number of guests, room preferences, special requests
Payment information — processed securely by our payment provider / booking engine; we do not store full card details ourselves
Account details — if you create an account or subscribe to updates, your login and marketing preferences
Browsing and interaction data — pages you visit on our Website, how you arrived at the site, links you click, time spent on pages, and device/browser information
Communications — any messages, enquiries, or feedback you send us via forms, email, or phone

We collect personal information when you:
Make a booking or enquiry through our Website or booking engine
Subscribe to our newsletter or marketing emails
Fill out a contact form
Browse our Website (via cookies and tracking technologies — see Cookies and Tracking Technologies)
Contact us directly by phone or email

We use your personal information to:
Process and manage your bookings and enquiries
Provide customer service and respond to your questions
Send transactional communications (booking confirmations, receipts, stay reminders)
Send marketing communications — if you sign up or opt in, we send personalised emails such as special offers, promotions, seasonal packages, and news about the resort
Understand how visitors use our Website so we can improve content, navigation, and the overall experience
Personalise the content and offers you see, based on the pages you’ve viewed and your booking history
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

Our Website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to understand visitor behaviour and deliver a more relevant experience.
Braze: We use Braze, a customer engagement platform, to help us understand how visitors interact with our Website — including which pages are viewed, how the site was reached, and general browsing activity — and to deliver personalised marketing communications to guests who have signed up (for example, tailored offers and emails based on the rooms or pages you’ve shown interest in).
Other tracking on our site may include standard analytics cookies (e.g. to measure overall traffic and site performance) and functional cookies (e.g. to remember your booking search preferences).
You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time. Please note that disabling cookies may affect certain features of the Website, such as personalised content or saved search preferences.

If you sign up for our mailing list, opt in during a booking, or otherwise consent to receive marketing:
We will send you emails about offers, promotions, and updates relevant to {{name}}
Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link — you can opt out at any time
Opting out of marketing emails will not affect transactional emails related to an active or upcoming booking

We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with:
Service providers who help us operate the Website and business, including: Braze (marketing automation and behavioural tracking)
Our booking engine / property management system provider (booking processing)
Payment processors (secure payment handling)
Website hosting and analytics providers
Legal or regulatory bodies, where required by law, or to protect our rights, guests, or property
Some of these providers (including Braze) may store or process data on servers located outside Australia, including in the United States. Where this occurs, we take reasonable steps to ensure your information continues to be handled in line with this policy and applicable privacy laws.

We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect your personal information from misuse, loss, unauthorised access, modification, or disclosure. This includes secure storage of booking and contact data and restricting access to authorised staff and service providers only. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy — for example, for the duration of your guest relationship with us, plus a reasonable period afterward for record-keeping, accounting, and legal purposes — unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

You have the right to:
Ask us what personal information we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate or outdated information
Request deletion of your personal information, subject to any legal obligations we have to retain it
Withdraw consent to marketing communications at any time
Lodge a complaint about how we’ve handled your personal information
To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below. If you’re not satisfied with our response, you can lodge a complaint with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) at www.oaic.gov.au.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements.

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us:
